Tiszakorod Jewish Cemetery 1

Jewish Cemetery · Petőfi utca 26, Hungary

Not demolished. Tiszakóród reportedly had two Jewish cemeteries; this one was established as early as 1895, per that year's cadastral map, though no legible tombstones survive to confirm further details of its operation. The Jewish population peaked at 51 in 1880 and 1910, later declining to 27 by 1941; per the Yad Vashem database, about 52 Jews from Tiszakóród were murdered in the Holocaust — more than the town's own recorded prewar Jewish population, reflecting deaths of community members who had already left the village before the war.
